title: Fabienne
creator_credit: Jacques Godbout, Andre Belleau and National Film Board of Canada
brief_description: She is a night club entertainer, in her way a highly successful exponent of her art, but there are moments when the admiration of her Montreal following is not enough. “Fabienne” is the portrait of a woman who has achieved enviable fame but is still far from content. (Award: Evian) Credits include: photographer by Guy Borremans; editing by Jacques Godbout, Gilles Groulx; music by Pierre Letourneau and sound by Joseph Champagne.
